title: Suggestions for review — pick a path before implementing
workflow: Reviewer picks option A/B/C (or rejects); the verdict is logged and only then implemented. Nothing here is implemented while status is 'proposed'.

rows.title: Decide how market prices will be obtained (or accept permanent blanks)
rows.context: Every market column, G7, real ROI and rewards are blocked by the absence of an official price source (Q01, FB-01).

options.text: License a historical + live odds archive (cost: money; unblocks G7, B02/B03, real staking)
Keep market columns permanently blank and run the project price-independent only (free; honest; rewards stay 0)
Record manual third-party screenshots as 'observed non-official' prices, labelled everywhere (free; weaker evidence)

rows.cost: A: paid / B: free / C: free
rows.risk: A: cost + licence terms; B: no edge measurement ever; C: evidence-quality disputes
rows.recommendation: B now (keeps every published number verifiable), revisit A if the project is funded

rows.title: Re-read the remaining 105 official game pages line by line
rows.context: 105 of 137 feed rows are aggregate-verified only (Q03, FB-03).

options.text: Fetch all 105 remaining official game pages and compare row by row (free, ~1–2 hours of fetches)
Accept aggregate verification + 32-game sample as sufficient (free; disclose forever)

rows.risk: A: none (read-only) / B: a transcription error in weeks 2–8 would survive

rows.title: Pre-register a paired test vs the better-record baseline
rows.context: Model 0.673 vs record baseline 0.635 on the same sample; the comparison was post-hoc (Q05).

options.text: Pre-register McNemar vs better-record now; evaluate only on Week 11+ games
Leave as a disclosed post-hoc diagnostic

rows.risk: A: none if evaluated only forward

rows.title: Resolve the depth-order source for all 32 clubs
rows.context: Both candidate routes are unverified for all 32 clubs (Q04, E13).

options.text: Per-club official depth-chart pages, verified club by club — currently 404 on nfl.com
Derive depth from snap counts if an official snap-count source exists
Do not build the backup-deficiency feature until one route is verified for all 32 clubs

rows.evidence: nfl.com team depth-chart 404; no official snap-count feed.
rows.risk: A/B: may not exist; C: feature stays unbuilt
rows.recommendation: C now (do not build on unverified depth), pursue A/B in parallel

rows.title: Add a control baseline to every leaderboard run

options.text: Coin-flip + favorites-only + better-record baselines on every run

rows.evidence: Current backtest already includes coin-flip + record baselines.

rows.title: Schedule the immutable multi-day availability snapshots
rows.context: Only a single availability capture exists today; it cannot support backtesting (E11/E24).

options.text: Schedule Wed/Thu/Fri captures of the injury report + depth + inactives with retained hashes
Keep the single capture and disclose the limitation

rows.evidence: Ledger schema frozen; no capture history retained.
rows.cost: A: one automation session / B: zero
rows.risk: A: source-schema drift needs the drift alarm (F05)

rows.title: Archive weekly injury reports for past seasons
rows.context: The only way to test whether designations change outcomes (E14/E16/E21).

options.text: Build a multi-season injury archive and compute designation play-rates with CIs
Accept that 'Questionable' cannot be calibrated empirically this season

rows.evidence: No historical injury archive in the repo.
rows.cost: A: a multi-season ingest / B: zero
rows.risk: A: historical availability of official reports
rows.recommendation: B this season; plan A for the next

rows.title: Pick one canonical dashboard among the 17+ NFL namespaces
rows.context: Overlapping namespaces multiply maintenance and confuse review (Q07).

options.text: Adopt this consolidated dashboard as canonical and link the rest as archives
Adopt nfl-book as canonical (most complete single slice)
Keep all namespaces and add a clear canonical index

rows.evidence: 17+ namespaces on the board; this session's dashboard is the cross-namespace view.
rows.risk: A/B: archived namespaces stop being maintained
rows.recommendation: A (this dashboard is the decision-readiness view the brief asked for)
